translation.name: Kalam Baybol Buk Gor minim nuk kisin angayak

content: Enjol Ak Jon Nup Buk Ñek Ñiŋak

Pen tip ak niŋnik; enjol kalrimey yimb bap semb biyoŋ nimb mis apek. Enjol kun ak nup, semb kom kom gakniŋ, tiybeñ ak jun nup ak paŋg gaw giy, jomluk nuk ak, pumb rek yiniy, tomb kind nuk ak, mon yiniy maŋlaŋ gip rek ak gak. Nuk semb biyoŋ nimb apiy,
tomb yipund kind ak ñiŋg solwara ar ak tawiy, aŋind kind ak lum ar ak tawiy, buk sikoy band bap mikal giy dimdiyiŋg,
kayn layon minim rek ak aŋgek, timuk onep ar ak minim gunap pen aŋgyak.
Minim aŋgyak kun ak tikayin aŋgen, minim bap semb biyoŋ nimb aŋgak, “Minim kun ak sek ma tiknimin aŋgak.”
Pen enjol tomb piskind ak ñiŋg solwara ar taw mindek, piskind ak lum ar taw mindek niŋnik ak, ñin yipund kind ak dand araniy Gor miñmon biyoŋ yomiy aŋgak,
“Yesek ma apiyn. Biyomb perper mindeniŋgamb ak; mankumb, solwara, semb biyoŋ maŋgiysek gayak rek, yimb nup diy niŋind yimb aspiyn. Miñiy tapin mindiy mer;

won biy nep enjol ar ak, biykul nuk puŋgakniŋ, Gor giniŋgayn aŋgak rek giniŋgamb. Biynimb gok minim kun ak ma niŋyiŋgipay ak pen; nuk bi minim nup aŋgep gok kuyip gos ñek, aŋgeyak niŋnuk rek, miñiy maŋ asaw: pisnep miseŋ giniŋgamb aŋgak.”
Pen minim bap semb biyoŋ nimb yip tip ak aŋgiy aŋgak, “Enjol tomb piskind ak solwara ar taw mindip, piskind ak man ar taw mindip anup am aŋgey, buk sikoy mikal giy di mindip ak, nip ñinimuŋ aŋgak.”

Kun aŋgek, enjol mindek ak amiy, yip buk sikoy kayaŋ ak ñan aŋgen, yip ñiyiŋg aŋgak, “Diy ñiŋan. Ñimbey, meŋg miŋgan nip ak bum ñiŋg yindik gip rek giniŋgamb ak pen, koŋgiy namb biyaŋ amiy, timey giniŋgamb aŋgak.”
Aŋgek, buk minim kun ak diy ñimben, bum ñiŋg yindik rek gak ak pen; ñimb namb biyaŋ ayen, timey gak.
Pen yip aŋgyak, “Biynimb miñmon keykey, wak keykey, minim yimb keykey kiyŋ kiyk gok sek, kisen kuyip yerer giniŋgamb ak, minim gunap sek aŋgniŋgamban aŋgyak.”
